subject: mathematics
content: The largest value of $$a$$, for which the perpendicular distance of the plane containing the lines $$ \vec{r}=(\hat{i}+\hat{j})+\lambda(\hat{i}+a \hat{j}-\hat{k})$$ and $$\vec{r}=(\hat{i}+\hat{j})+\mu(-\hat{i}+\hat{j}-a \hat{k})$$ from the point $$(2,1,4)$$ is $$\sqrt{3}$$, is _________.
